verdict.rationale: A government business-filing portal could plausibly offer event-driven automation such as status-change alerts, webhooks or deadline-triggered actions, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows users can define rules that fire actions on events. The only notification feature is fixed vote-by-mail ballot tracking for voters, which is not user-defined automation. Probes also found no API or OpenAPI surface through which such automation could be built.
